# Microbiome_Metabolomics_HIV

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

This repository includes data, R codes, and outputs for the following paper:

**Fouladi et al. A taxon-specific measurement of disruption in a multi-modal study of microbiomes and metabolomes reveals system-wide dysbiosis preceding HIV-1 infection. 2025. Nature Communications.**

Please refer to *data availability* in the paper to obtain the metadata for this project

The main script to run all the analyses is   *code/data_analysis_workflow.R*
